name: ESO 540-032 (Hubble)
blurb: ESO 540-032, a transition-type dwarf galaxy in the Sculptor Group, seen by Hubble.
label: eso540032-hubble
story: ESO 540-032 is a small transition-type dwarf galaxy in the Sculptor Group, with traits of both early-type and irregular dwarfs. It still holds a reservoir of hydrogen gas and a sprinkling of young stars.

claims.text: ESO 540-032 is a transition-type dwarf in the Sculptor group
Hubble ACS data were used to study it
It contains a population of young stars
Transition-type dwarfs resemble Phoenix and LGS3, between early-type and irregular dwarfs
